name: Ice mass

source.name: IMBIE
source.citation: IMBIE Team. Mass balance of the Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets.

describe.what: How much ice an ice sheet holds, compared with the start of the record.
describe.whyItMatters: Ice lost from the ice sheets raises sea level; about 360 Gt is 1 mm.

notes: Totals per ice sheet, reconciled from many satellite surveys. No map at this resolution.

name: Sea level, long record

source.name: NASA JPL_RECON_GMSL
source.citation: Frederikse et al. (2020), The causes of sea-level rise since 1900.

describe.what: Global mean sea level since 1900, reconstructed from tide gauges and models.
describe.whyItMatters: Shows how fast sea level rose before satellites, to compare with today.

notes: Separate from the satellite record; never joined to it.
